terms.definition: A reason for using a medicine or treatment.
A factor that makes a treatment inadvisable.
terms.example: An allergy may be a contraindication.

terms.meaning: phản ứng có hại của thuốc
terms.definition: An unintended harmful response to a medicine.
terms.example: The patient reported an adverse drug reaction.

items.title: 3 Pharmacy English words in 30 seconds: indication, contraindication, adverse drug reaction #Shorts
items.caption:
• indication /ˌɪndɪˈkeɪʃən/ = chỉ định
• contraindication /ˌkɒntrəˌɪndɪˈkeɪʃən/ = chống chỉ định
• adverse drug reaction /ˈædvɜːs drʌɡ riˈækʃən/ = phản ứng có hại của thuốc
